Kuro TV - 1.5 beta (take 9)
===========================

File      : Kuro-tv-beta-1.5.apk
Size      : 48,677,091 bytes
sha256    : d8073d59635cee20f8148840ef8d6ca9e26116a20da86dfa6250f86b6b06314d
md5       : eda0f99537b937ba6b51761ab3aa1bee
version   : 1.5-beta  (versionCode 92 - unchanged)
signing   : v2, CN=Kuro Anime  (same key as 1.0-1.4)
Delivery  : Google Drive only. NOT on GitHub, no tag, no release.

Install
-------
Straight over take 8. No uninstall, data, theme and settings kept.

Theme colour moved into Settings
--------------------------------
It is no longer a card in Account. It is the first block inside

    Settings  ->  Appearance and startup

right at the top of that group, above Site view. Pick a colour there and every
screen, dialog, player control and status bar follows it, exactly as before; the
choice is still saved on the phone. The shell's old eight-swatch "Accent color"
row is gone from that group - it tinted only the menu and would have been a
second, conflicting accent control next to the real one.

Twenty accents now, in the same three groups

  Signature   Teal      Violet    Plum       Graphite
  Cool        Sky       Ice       Royal      Sapphire
  Indigo      Emerald   Mint      Lime
  Warm        Citron    Gold      Amber      Sunset
  Coral       Rose      Crimson   Magenta

  new in this take:  Plum #d252e6   Ice #25b4e0      Sapphire #4f7ce8
                     Mint #32e2ad   Gold #e9c25a     Coral   #ed9183

All twenty are generated from the same palette tool as the original ten, so the
fourteen you already had are byte-for-byte unchanged - nothing you liked moved.

Also fixed: in take 8 the Royal, Lime, Citron and Rose tiles showed an empty
grey circle instead of a colour chip, and choosing one left the preview strip in
the previous theme's colours. All twenty now have a swatch and their own preview
colours; picking one repaints the preview, the picker and the whole app.

Account: the LOCAL card is gone
-------------------------------
The "Private profile / LOCAL" row is removed from Account - hidden before the
page paints and taken out of the page itself, so it cannot be tapped or tabbed
to either.

Everything from earlier takes still stands
------------------------------------------
  * the header round arrow / Account card: one tap checks, downloads, installs
  * Settings > Developer opens the Discord profile, deep-linked into Discord
  * motion: opening film, press spring on every control, scroll-linked movement
  * no tap ripple, no Motion - Beta card, no "One library" banner on Home

Known
-----
The updater still reads GitHub's latest release (1.4, older than this beta), so
it will tell you that you are already ahead until something newer is published.
